sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_bases ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT DEFAULT '', kb_version INT DEFAULT 1, embedding_model TEXT DEFAULT 'bge-m3', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_tenant ON knowledge_bases(tenant_id)
ALTER TABLE knowledge_bases DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS default_lang
ALTER TABLE knowledge_bases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS usage_contexts JSONB DEFAULT '["agent","direct_chat","webpage"]'::jsonb
ALTER TABLE knowledge_bases ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS source_kind TEXT DEFAULT 'manual'

UPDATE knowledge_bases SET source_kind = 'webpage_auto', usage_contexts = '["webpage"]'::jsonb WHERE source_kind = 'manual' AND name LIKE '🌐 %' AND description LIKE 'Auto-generated knowledge base for webpage%'

UPDATE knowledge_bases SET source_kind = 'notebook_auto', usage_contexts = '["webpage"]'::jsonb WHERE source_kind = 'manual' AND name LIKE '📓 %' AND description LIKE 'Auto-generated knowledge base for notebook%'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_kb_source_kind ON knowledge_bases(source_kind)
UPDATE knowledge_bases SET usage_contexts = '["agent","direct_chat"]'::jsonb WHERE source_kind = 'manual' AND usage_contexts = '["agent","direct_chat","webpage"]'::jsonb
UPDATE knowledge_bases SET usage_contexts = usage_contexts || '["ai_step"]'::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE usage_contexts ? 'agent' AND NOT (usage_contexts ? 'ai_step')
UPDATE knowledge_bases SET usage_contexts = '["agent","direct_chat","ai_step"]'::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE usage_contexts IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, knowledge_base_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_bases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT, source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'text', source_uri TEXT, lang TEXT DEFAULT 'unknown', content_hash TEXT, chunk_count INT DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() )

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.source_kind = 'system_managed' ORDER BY kb.name

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.tenant_id = $1 AND kb.source_kind = ANY($2) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.tenant_id = $1 AND kb.source_kind = ANY($2) AND kb.usage_contexts ? $3 AND NOT (kb.usage_contexts ? $4) UNION SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.source_kind = 'system_managed' AND kb.system_slug = ANY($5) AND kb.usage_contexts ? $6 AND NOT (kb.usage_contexts ? $7) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.source_kind = ANY($1) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.tenant_id = $1 AND kb.source_kind = ANY($2) AND NOT (kb.usage_contexts ? $3) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE (kb.tenant_id = $1 OR (kb.organization_id = ANY($2) AND kb.source_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'project_files' AND kb.is_published = TRUE)) AND kb.source_kind = ANY($3) AND kb.usage_contexts ? $4 UNION SELECT kb.*, COALESCE(d.doc_count, 0) AS document_count, COALESCE(d.doc_count_all, 0) AS document_count_all, COALESCE(d.total_chunks, 0) AS total_chunks, d.last_document_at FROM knowledge_bases kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT knowledge_base_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS doc_count, COUNT(*) AS doc_count_all, SUM(chunk_count) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS total_chunks, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('processed','redacted')) AS last_document_at FROM documents GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ) d ON d.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE kb.source_kind = 'system_managed' AND kb.system_slug = ANY($5) AND kb.usage_contexts ? $6 ORDER BY created_at DESC
